ledger.claim: The native varṇa theory (Sarkar) assigns acoustic roots to the vowels (a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ ḷ e ai o au) and to aṃ/aḥ; none are present in the current table.
ledger.implies: root-bearing / primitive-like content per theory; but per-unit content is MISSING (not in b1_2 lexicon)
ledger.inference_label: asserts a theory-level claim; the per-vowel root CONTENT is not reproduced in-repo

ledger.claim: Patent architecture assigns vowels a positional FIELD role (first consonant=seed, final consonant=transformer, interior consonants=unresolved, vowels=field); an opt-in variant lets a word-initial vowel take a seed role.
ledger.implies: structural/positional role, NOT a per-vowel meaning; this is the DEPRECATED English pipeline, not the native theory
ledger.inference_label: engineering role of the English apparatus; explicitly not a native-theory claim

ledger.claim: Vowel-initial positional-polarity variant reads authored per-vowel polar-state fields from a development lexicon; labelled NOT semantic evidence and keyed off English EY→e, not Sanskrit a.
ledger.implies: authored vowel poles EXIST in a dev lexicon but are unattested and English-motivated
ledger.inference_label: development-only; the memo itself disclaims semantic/ontology/Sanskrit-privilege weight

ledger.claim: By construction, the a-privative prefix and vowel length carry meaning-flipping contrast: vidyā↔avidyā, himsā↔ahimsā (privative a), nara↔nārī (length/gender) — identical consonant skeletons, opposite/contrastive meanings.
ledger.scope: privative a + vowel length (a natural experiment on the frozen corpus)
ledger.implies: vowels/prefix/length are semantically LOAD-BEARING (existence proof); refutes consonant-only as a COMPLETE theory
ledger.inference_label: structural existence proof about WHERE contrast lives — not a per-vowel pole assignment

ledger.claim: The active native table (v3.1) contains 34 consonant entries and NO vowel / anusvāra / visarga / candrabindu entries.
ledger.implies: the semantic content for every missing category is absent — not droppable, not yet authored

ledger.claim: Open questions in the staging plan: 'is an aspirated stop a distinct varṇa with its own root, or a modifier? does anusvāra carry a nasal root? does word-position weight a varṇa?'
ledger.implies: the role of anusvāra (primitive-with-root vs modifier) is explicitly OPEN in-repo

ledger.claim: The frozen native parser preserves vowels/anusvāra/visarga/candrabindu as ordered atomic units with NO meaning; 45% of seed-corpus phonological tokens are these missing categories.
ledger.implies: structural preservation is done; the missing categories dominate token frequency
